asset.prompt:
Create a premium hand-painted 2D fantasy action-game LIGHTNING DASH SURGE animation spritesheet on actual transparent RGBA. This is the powerful added outer electrical mantle around a knight rocketing to the RIGHT; draw ONLY the electricity, no character, sword, machine, objects, text, ground, scenery, or matte. Exactly 12 consecutive genuinely different frames arranged in a regular 4-column 3-row grid, square equal cells, chronological row-major. No grid lines. Fixed front convergence at x=82%,y=50% in every cell, open central hole around x=72%,y=50% where the character will remain visible. Keep minimum 6% transparent margin at all edges of every cell. Canvas 4:3.
STYLE: high-end sharply defined WHITE lightning cores with intense ice-CYAN edge light and deeper BLUE secondary forks. ELECTRICITY with irregular angular branching topology, not smooth smoke, fire, vague fog, solid ribbons, feathered wings, or dense glowing blobs. Stronger and more spectacular than a small bolt: a very wide horizontal fan of FIVE major forked lightning streams sweeping backward to the LEFT, upper and lower branches curl around the empty center to create a powerful electrically charged dash silhouette. Very long spine, some crisp diagonal sub-branches, fine separated pinprick sparks. Branches remain separated by generous transparent negative spaces so background and body silhouette show through.
ANIMATION: frames1-2 short tense electrostatic branches gather above and below the leading edge, leaving central hole. Frame3 sudden broad electric eruption spreads leftward. Frames4-6 enormous lengthened five-stream mantle with jagged main paths each differently forked; frame5 strongest white highlights and shower of tiny sparks, a thin distorted electrical shock arc wraps only the front outer edge. Frame7 the upper and lower streams whip and fork again. Frame8 entire mantle starts shearing into separated longitudinal jagged branches. Frames9-10 branches snap into floating electric fragments and blue needle sparks. Frame11 only several disconnected crooked blue filaments. Frame12 very few dim blue sparks. Every frame is a different authored drawing with evolving branch shapes, not a single picture repositioned, scaled, rotated, or alpha faded. Vivid and explosive flight energy, crisp silhouettes at small game size; avoid thick opaque blue haze, perfectly symmetrical branches, plain star icons and over-bloom.
